reply.rationale: No defensible morphological paradigm is attested. The symbols A–N are opaque one-character procedure labels whose meanings mention variable parameters ({face}, {intensity}, {dur}), but those parameters are not realized by any overt subparts of the symbols in the supplied codebook. There are no multi-symbol codes, no minimal pairs in a shared frame, and no evidence that U/R or x combine productively with any other symbol. The standalone symbols a–n are symptom labels, not declared members of a recoverable substitution class inside larger codes. Under the evidence requirements and the opaque-index test, the safest analysis is a flat lexicon with every supplied symbol treated as lexical.
